```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(nlme)
library(lme4)
```

```{r}
caterpillar_data <- read.csv(here("data", "clean data", "caterpillar_data.csv"))

#caterpillar_data <- caterpillar_data %>%
  #filter(!is.na(hatch_date)) 

caterpillar_data$pupal_treatment <- as.factor(caterpillar_data$pupal_treatment)
caterpillar_data$hatch_date <- as.Date(caterpillar_data$hatch_date)
caterpillar_data$weight_1 <- as.numeric(caterpillar_data$weight_1)
caterpillar_data$weight_2 <- as.numeric(caterpillar_data$weight_2)

#turn all weights into mg
caterpillar_data$weight_1 <- caterpillar_data$weight_1 * 1000
caterpillar_data$weight_2 <- caterpillar_data$weight_2 * 1000
caterpillar_data$weight3 <- caterpillar_data$weight3 * 1000
caterpillar_data$weight4 <- caterpillar_data$weight4 * 1000
caterpillar_data$weight_5 <- caterpillar_data$weight_5 * 1000

#remove rows where hatched is NA, and where there are not at least two weights
caterpillar_data <- caterpillar_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(hatched)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(weight3))

```

```{r}
#fix the names of the columns
names(caterpillar_data) <- names(caterpillar_data) %>%
  gsub("^weight([0-9]+)$", "weight_\\1", .)

#turn the data into long format
long_data <- caterpillar_data %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(weight|weighday)_\\d+$"),
    names_to = c(".value", "time"),
    names_pattern = "(weight|weighday)_(\\d+)"
  )

#save weighday as a date
long_data$weighday <- as.Date(long_data$weighday)

#add a days post hatch column
long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(days_post_hatch = as.numeric(weighday - hatch_date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na("weight"))
```

```{r}
#remove rows with NAs
long_data <- long_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(weight),
    !is.na(days_post_hatch),
    !is.na(eggID)
  ) %>%
  mutate("log_weight" = log(weight))

#USING RAW WEIGHTS

#group the data by eggID, and then for each eggID estimate the best-fitting line. then extract the coefficient of that line (the slope). This is the growth rate of the caterpillar as mg per day/
slopes <- long_data %>%
  group_by(eggID) %>%
  summarise(
    slope = coef(lm(log_weight ~ days_post_hatch))[2])
```

```{r}
#plot the relationship between growth rate and egg size
growth_rate <- ggplot(caterpillar_data, aes(x = size_01, y = slope)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  labs( x = expression(Egg~area~(mm^2)), y = expression(Relative~growth~rate~(mg %.% mg^-1 %.% day^-1)), title = "B) Larval growth rate") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0.18, 0.26, by = 0.02),
    limits = c(0.18, 0.26)) +
    theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),            # increases all text
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),      # axis titles bigger
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),       # axis tick labels bigger
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),     # legend text bigger
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20)
    )

growth_rate


#now make a model of growth rate and size
model <- lmer(slope ~ size_01 + pupal_treatment + (1|clutchID), data = caterpillar_data)
summary(model)
AIC(model)

plot(model)
qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model))

library(DHARMa)
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(model)
plot(sim_res)


hist(long_data$weight)

#AIC with using log weights in -236
# size is significant but pupal treatment isn't

#AIC using raw weights is 288
#neither size or pupal treatment is significant
```

```{r}
#random intercepts and random slopes
model <- lmer(weight ~ days_post_hatch * size_01 + pupal_treatment + (1 | clutchID) + (days_post_hatch | eggID), data = long_data)

summary(model)

#random intercepts only
model <- lmer(weight ~ days_post_hatch * size_01 + pupal_treatment + (1 | clutchID/eggID), data = long_data)
summary(model)


model <- lmer(weight ~ days_post_hatch * size_01 + days_post_hatch * pupal_treatment + (1|clutchID/eggID), data = long_data)

summary(model)

plot(model)


slopes <- long_data %>%
  group_by(eggID) %>%
  summarise({
    m1 <- lm(weight ~ days_post_hatch)
    m2 <- lm(log(weight) ~ days_post_hatch)
    
    pred1 <- predict(m1)
    pred2 <- exp(predict(m2))  # back-transform
    
    rmse_raw <- sqrt(mean((weight - pred1)^2))
    rmse_log <- sqrt(mean((weight - pred2)^2))
    
    tibble(
      rmse_raw = rmse_raw,
      rmse_log = rmse_log
    )
  })

residuals_df <- long_data %>%
  group_by(eggID) %>%
  mutate(
    resid_raw = resid(lm(weight ~ days_post_hatch)),
    fitted_raw = fitted(lm(weight ~ days_post_hatch)),
    
    resid_log = resid(lm(log(weight) ~ days_post_hatch)),
    fitted_log = fitted(lm(log(weight) ~ days_post_hatch))
  )


ggplot(residuals_df, aes(fitted_raw, resid_raw)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") 

ggplot(residuals_df, aes(fitted_log, resid_log)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")
```
